config.loss: Mean squared CFA error divided by each camera plane mean core variance, floor1e-8; equal plane weighting.
config.data: Fresh deterministic procedural textures/constants/ramps/edges/waves, identity280000000+seed*100000+serial, eightfamilycycle; physical phases balanced acrosscycles; streaming, no photo targets.
config.noise: Existing three experimental measured-law Gaussian scenarios, observed-signal sigma, no clipping, zero noise every127 observations.
config.limits: Bootstrap only, procedural content not sensor truth, no reserved cohort, no production or photographic qualification.
